headings.rules: Never use Inter for headings. Use extreme weight contrast. The overlapping year should be massive but capped at text-6xl+ fluidly or customized specifically as a background element with low opacity.

body.rules: Clean, highly legible for narrative copy. Left-aligned.

telemetry_data.rules: Must be used for all telemetry data, sector readouts, and timeline years to maintain tabular alignment.

labels.rules: Overlines, circuit names, and stat labels.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro & Luxury F1 Museum Hybrid
colors.interaction_accent: Current theme context determines accent (e.g., semantic rank or active era color). Use text shadow or 1px glow to ensure it pops against dark backgrounds.
colors.rules: No generic gradients. Use tinted deep grays (obsidian). Era markers must be tiny (e.g., 2px wide vertical lines or 4px dots). Do NOT use teal green for standard dashboard elements, reserve strictly for the Mercedes era marker.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the primary background (`bg-[url('/noise.png')] opacity-5`).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For floating telemetry or sticky timeline spine: `backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/40 border border-white/5`.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes (`border-white/10`) for structural definition, no soft drop shadows. Grid items can use `border-r border-b border-white/5`.
visual_enhancers.images: Feathered photography with `mask-image: linear-gradient(...)` to dissolve seamlessly into the black background. Overlay `bg-black/40` max to keep images visible.

era_spine.visuals: Ultra-thin continuous line segmented by era. Each segment glows slightly with era_marker color when active. Title streaks represented by subtle widening of the line or glowing dots on championship years.

season_storytelling.description: Editorial band with headline, narrative, and signature moment.
season_storytelling.placement: Integrated into the left layout column, near the overlapping year.
season_storytelling.visuals: No cards. Plain text with high typographic contrast. Headline (`text-3xl font-black`), Narrative (`text-sm text-gray-400 max-w-md leading-relaxed`), Signature Moment (`text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-white border-l-2 pl-3`).

interactive_telemetry.description: Animated sector readouts and career-peak comparison.
interactive_telemetry.placement: Embedded near circuit lists and ghost path.
interactive_telemetry.visuals: Minimalist horizontal bars (1px or 2px height) for peak comparison. Sector readouts are inline block text in monospace, changing values via Framer Motion on hover/focus.

desktop.structure: Asymmetric Bento Grid (Mode A / Hybrid). `grid-cols-12 gap-8`. Left col-span-5 for editorial/storytelling. Right col-span-7 for the feathered image dissolve, ghost telemetry path, and circuit list.
desktop.alignment: Left-aligned content to contrast the vast right-side visual.

mobile.rules: Compress narrative copy (`line-clamp-3`). Retain era spine as a horizontal bar at the bottom. Telemetry becomes swipeable or simplified. Image max-height 50vh, feathered at the bottom.

grids_layouts.anti_crowding: Use `p-8` to `p-16` padding blocks. Group related data tightly, leave massive negative space between distinct logical blocks.

motion.transitions: Use Transform and Opacity only for performance.

interactions.circuit_hover: Hovering a circuit reveals its sector readouts and highlights its node on the ghost telemetry path. `transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease`.
interactions.era_change: Crossfade backgrounds and text colors when changing eras. Era spine line animates its height/progress.

motion.rules: No new infinite loops. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Ensure all grid children handling motion use direct `motion.div` wraps without nesting.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has `text-shadow` or gradients to meet APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.focus: Distinct `focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white/50` on era spine buttons and circuit lists.
accessibility.aria: Use `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative ghost telemetry SVG paths.

media.image_handling: Images act as the hero/backdrop on the right side. Do not use generic full-screen overlays; use gradient masks to fade into the data section.
media.responsive: Images must scale proportionally without causing horizontal overflow. Use `object-cover` with precise focal points.

hero_car_active.description: High-speed Formula 1 car in action (Placeholder for active season racing shot)

hero_sparks.description: Formula 1 car speeding across finish line emitting sparks

pit_crew.description: Pit crew readying car during intense race event

hamilton_celebration.description: Joyful celebration at F1 event with Brazilian flag

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Do not touch the existing SpatialExperience, Lenis setup, or exact camera stop logic. You are injecting UI layers cleanly into the active-only DOM state.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a `data.js` or modify the existing state to include the curated 2007-2025 storytelling map: headline, narrative, signature race.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement the Era Spine component using simple absolutely positioned fixed divs on the edge of the screen, tracking the current selected year.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Embed the interactive telemetry (sector readouts, peak comparison bars) directly alongside the circuit/locality list. Ensure hover events trigger state updates that highlight the path.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use Shadcn Card components for this layout. Rely on pure HTML/Tailwind divs with semantic HTML5 tags.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add `data-testid` to every clickable year, era navigation dot, and interactive circuit item.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Use `framer-motion` for the telemetry bars expanding on mount/update (using pure scaleX transforms).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Dark colors look good when used independently.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical, intentional positioning.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and delicate 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with `backdrop-blur-xl` and desaturated semi-transparent dark backgrounds.
NEVER apply `transition: all`. Specify properties to prevent breaking transforms.
Do NOT center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Keep text reading naturally left-aligned.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do not use placeholder text for missing images. Use provided image URLs.
All test ids must follow kebab-case role-based convention.
